mapper.select: SELECT item.id AS orderItemId, item.order_id AS orderId, orders.user_id AS buyerUserId, sku.product_id AS productId, item.quantity, orders.status AS orderStatus, shipment.status AS shipmentStatus, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale_items refunded JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id = refunded.case_id WHERE refunded.order_item_id = item.id AND sale.status = 'REFUNDED') AS refundedQuantity FROM order_items item JOIN orders ON orders.id = item.order_id JOIN skus sku ON sku.id = item.sku_id LEFT JOIN shipments shipment ON shipment.order_id = orders.id WHERE item.id = #{orderItemId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM product_reviews WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_reviews (order_item_id, product_id, buyer_user_id, rating, content, counted_in_summary) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{buyerUserId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{countedInSummary})
INSERT INTO product_review_images (review_id, media_id, phase, position) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{mediaId}, #{phase}, #{position})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_item_id AS orderItemId, product_id AS productId, buyer_user_id AS buyerUserId, rating, follow_up_at AS followUpAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt, hidden_at AS hiddenAt, counted_in_summary AS countedInSummary FROM product_reviews WHERE id = #{reviewId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, order_item_id AS orderItemId, product_id AS productId, rating, counted_in_summary AS countedInSummary FROM product_reviews WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale_items refunded JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id = refunded.case_id WHERE refunded.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND sale.status = 'REFUNDED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE product_reviews SET counted_in_summary = 0 WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND counted_in_summary = 1
UPDATE product_reviews SET follow_up = #{content}, follow_up_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND follow_up_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND hidden_at IS NULL
UPDATE product_reviews SET deleted_at = NOW(), counted_in_summary = 0 WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_reviews review JOIN order_items item ON item.id = review.order_item_id JOIN products product ON product.id = review.product_id JOIN shops shop ON shop.id = product.shop_id WHERE review.id = #{reviewId} AND review.deleted_at IS NULL AND review.hidden_at IS NULL AND product.status = 'ON_SALE' AND shop.enabled = 1 AND item.quantity > ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale_items refunded JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id = refunded.case_id WHERE refunded.order_item_id = item.id AND sale.status = 'REFUNDED' ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review_reports (review_id, reporter_user_id, reason) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT report.id, report.review_id AS reviewId, review.rating, review.content, review.follow_up AS followUp, report.reason, report.created_at AS createdAt FROM product_review_reports report JOIN product_reviews review ON review.id = report.review_id WHERE report.status = 'OPEN' AND report.id < #{afterId} ORDER BY report.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, review_id AS reviewId, status FROM product_review_reports WHERE id = #{reportId}
SELECT id, review_id AS reviewId, status FROM product_review_reports WHERE id = #{reportId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE product_review_reports SET status = 'RESOLVED', decision = #{decision}, handled_by_user_id = #{adminId}, handled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE product_reviews SET hidden_at = COALESCE(hidden_at, NOW()), counted_in_summary = 0 WHERE id = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review_moderation_audit (review_id, report_id, admin_user_id, decision, reason) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{reportId}, #{adminId}, #{decision}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM products product JOIN shops shop ON shop.id = product.shop_id WHERE product.id = #{productId} AND product.status = 'ON_SALE' AND shop.enabled = 1 )

SELECT review.id, review.rating, review.content, review.follow_up AS followUp, review.created_at AS createdAt, review.follow_up_at AS followUpAt FROM product_reviews review JOIN order_items item ON item.id = review.order_item_id WHERE review.product_id = #{productId} AND review.deleted_at IS NULL AND review.hidden_at IS NULL AND item.quantity > ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale_items refunded JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id = refunded.case_id WHERE refunded.order_item_id = item.id AND sale.status = 'REFUNDED' ) AND review.id < #{afterId} ORDER BY review.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT review_id AS reviewId, media_id AS mediaId, phase FROM product_review_images WHERE review_id IN #{id} ORDER BY review_id DESC, phase, position

SELECT COALESCE(summary.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(summary.review_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(summary.rating_sum / summary.review_count, 2) END AS averageRating FROM products product LEFT JOIN product_review_summaries summary ON summary.product_id = product.id WHERE product.id = #{productId}
